issues.issue: Judgment call: the label could mean the county-distributed motor vehicle tax (motor vehicle tax) and not pro-rate state aid. Same choice in detail[3] and detail[19].

This is a bond-related fee paid from the Debt Service Fund, so it could be debt service interest (which includes fees). The detail[20] 'Bond Maintenance' line (professional/contract services) has the same question.
Garbage collection is a refuse service, so it could be utilities (refuse). The extractor's choice is defensible.
The extractor assumed that retiring warrants counts as negative other financing, with Warrants Issued 2,250 as debt_proceeds. The two net to zero and the identity holds.
